title: Weekly planning session
lead: Page to review the suggested week, swap/skip/lock meals, and confirm the plan (P0, P4).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** list generation (that slice consumes the confirmed plan).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: This is the one weekly habit larder asks for, so it has to take a few minutes.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body: None. Owner decisions: 2026-11-04 (ADR 0013 Rules, S19): everyone can plan (any paired person can edit the plan); the planning session is Saturday evening; 6 dinners and 1 open night, the open night chosen when planning; a skipped meal rolls to the next open night. 2026-11-05: one tap on 'swap' replaces the meal with the next-ranked alternative (no picker). The S20 'suggested week looks sensible on imported recipes' check was deferred to this slice or the S30 trial: run it here once imported and tagged recipes exist, otherwise leave it for S30.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Create the week's `meal_plan` from `suggest_week`.
2. Per night: swap, skip, lock, or pick any recipe.
3. Confirm saves the plan and fires a `plan_confirmed` hook (the list slice subscribes).
4. Mobile-first layout; one screen.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Web tests pass; the owner plans a real week in under 5 minutes.
